evaluation.method_note: REPRODUCIBLE audit of frozen machine issue #29's W41 forecast against final Master Monday and 168 observed W41 hours. All 12 required IDs are scored in order: SUPPORTED=100, MIXED=50, CONTRADICTED=0. Public-continuity arithmetic is 800/12=66.67%; the five structural calls average 80% in this internal parameter audit only, not as a public Market / Structure accuracy measure. Price Ranges use the established eight-envelope precision rule: each weekly or day-window BTC/ETH band passes only if both observed extrema fit. Only the two Day 1–2 bands pass, yielding 2/8=25%. Descriptive intraday calls are scored separately. Decision utility has no supplied execution outcome or rubric. The supplied prospective bridge targets W39, not W41 or W42.
